training.empty: No logs (the task produced no output, or the 106-day retention period has passed)
training.banner: Task logs: across all Pods of this task (Logs Insights). Asynchronous query; up to 10,000 rows per result.

inference.empty: No logs (the inference service produced no output, or the CloudWatch retention period has passed)
inference.banner: Endpoint logs: across all Pods of this endpoint (Logs Insights). Asynchronous query; up to 10,000 rows per result.

dynamo.empty: No logs (Dynamo inference produced no output, or the CloudWatch retention period has passed)
dynamo.banner: Task logs: across all Pods of this Dynamo inference service (frontend + worker, Logs Insights). Asynchronous query; up to 10,000 rows per result.

rayjob.empty: No logs (the Ray Job produced no system logs, or the CloudWatch retention period has passed)
rayjob.banner: Task logs: across all Pods of this Ray Job (head + worker, Logs Insights). Asynchronous query; up to 10,000 rows per result. Includes Ray system logs and the driver log on the head (output of your training script).

llmd.empty: No logs (llm-d inference produced no output, or the CloudWatch retention period has passed)
llmd.banner: Task logs: across all Pods of this llm-d inference service (LWS worker + gateway, Logs Insights). Asynchronous query; up to 10,000 rows per result.

devinstance.empty: No logs (the dev instance produced no logs, or the CloudWatch retention period has passed)
devinstance.banner: Task logs: across all Pods of this dev instance (Logs Insights). Asynchronous query; up to 10,000 rows per result. Includes logs from the main container workspace and the SSH setup container direct-ssh-init.
